name: YeastVar1011
description: YeastVar1011 connects yeast single-cell study questions to marker evidence, analysis methods, input requirements and documented research plans. The browser workstation covers quality control, cell states, expression variation, RNA dynamics, regulation, population genetics and evolution, with source-linked document, spreadsheet, diagram and JSON exports. A separate Linux x86_64 Snakemake workflow runs FastQC, STARsolo, samtools and MultiQC for an explicitly configured fixed contiguous CB/UMI layout with dedicated barcode and cDNA reads. It retains tagged BAM, Gene/GeneFull/SJ/Velocyto matrices and per-barcode QC; SLURM execution uses a site-configured profile. Original code and documentation use MIT; bundled components retain their own licenses.
